server.name: ceyloncharts-mcp-server
server.title: CeylonCharts
server.description: Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) market data for AI agents: live quotes and candlestick charts, historical OHLCV price history, financial statements, foreign-shareholding and top-20 shareholder data, corporate announcements and actions, market/sector indices, pre-computed technicals, a stock/index screener, market summaries, and macroeconomic indicators.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) data only — no other exchange is covered. Resolve a company with get_symbols first if unsure of its exact ticker; every other tool also accepts a bare ticker or company name directly (typos tolerated) and will return disambiguation candidates instead of data if the match is ambiguous, or a resolution note if it guessed a name/typo or defaulted to the voting-shares instrument for a company with multiple listed instruments. Use get_quotes for a live intraday price snapshot, get_ohlc_data for historical price series, get_chart for a rendered candlestick+volume image, get_financial_statement for detailed financials, and get_technicals / screen_stocks / screen_indices for pre-computed indicators and screening — prefer these over deriving the same metrics from raw OHLC data.

tool.name: get_ohlc_data
tool.title: Get OHLC price history
tool.description: Get OHLCV (open, high, low, close, volume) data for a CSE symbol. Prices are adjusted for splits by default (clean price action), but NOT for rights issues or dividends, unless requested. Defaults to the most recent 50 trading days; if more history is available the response says so and how to page further back with offset. Returns CSV (date,open,high,low,close,volume) preceded by a note if the symbol was resolved from a name/typo, if the company has other instruments, or if any corporate actions (splits/rights/dividends) fall within the requested range. If the input is ambiguous, returns JSON candidates instead.

to.description: End of an explicit date range to fetch, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to default to the latest available trading day.

from.description: Start of an explicit date range to fetch, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to use the default recent-trading-days window instead (see `limit`).

limit.description: Max trading days to return. The most recent matching days are selected first and then reordered chronologically before being returned — use `offset` to page further back in history.

offset.description: Skip this many of the most recent trading days before taking `limit` — use to page further back into history.

symbol.description: A CSE ticker (e.g. "SAMP" or "SAMP.N0000") or the company name (e.g. "Sampath Bank"). Typos are tolerated. A bare symbol or name defaults to the voting-shares instrument if the company has more than one listed instrument (voting/non-voting/rights/debentures/preferential) — the response notes the others if so. If the input is ambiguous, the response returns candidates instead of data; ask the user to pick one and call again with the exact symbol.

interval.description: Bar size for the returned series — use "weekly" or "monthly" to aggregate into coarser bars instead of daily candles.

adjust_rights.description: Adjust historical prices for past rights issues falling within the range, producing continuous pre-/post-issue price action.

adjust_splits.description: Adjust historical prices for stock splits and scrip/bonus share dividends.

adjust_dividends.description: Adjust historical prices for cash dividends, producing a total-return series — turn this on when the user is asking about total return / performance rather than raw price action.

tool.name: get_financial_statement
tool.title: Get financial statement
tool.description: Get full line-item detail for one financial statement (income statement, balance sheet, or cash flow statement) for a CSE symbol — every quarter available, one row per line item. Cash-flow figures are cumulative (year-to-date) while income-statement figures are per-quarter — don't diff adjacent columns on the cash flow statement as if they were quarterly deltas. Returns CSV (label,canonical_key,<one column per fiscal period>), or JSON candidates if the input is ambiguous.

symbol.description: A CSE ticker or the company name (e.g. "SAMP" or "Sampath Bank"). Typos are tolerated. Statements are entity-level, so any instrument suffix given is ignored. If the input is ambiguous, the response returns candidates instead of data; ask the user to pick one and call again with the exact symbol.

statement.description: Which financial statement to fetch — "income" (income statement), "balance" (balance sheet), or "cashflow" (cash flow statement; its figures are cumulative year-to-date rather than per-quarter, as noted above).

company_type.description: Most companies only publish a "group" (consolidated) statement. Omit this to try group first and automatically fall back to "company" (standalone) if group is unavailable — the response says which one was actually served. Pass explicitly to force one variant only, with no fallback.

tool.name: screen_stocks
tool.title: Screen stocks
tool.description: Screen CSE stocks by pre-computed technical criteria (moving-average position, relative-strength rating, 52-week range, unusual volume). Every filter is optional and AND-combined; omit a filter to not constrain on it. E.g. above_ema50=true & above_ema200=true & rs_rating_min=80 finds market-leading uptrends; is_52w_high=true finds stocks making new highs today; vol_vs_sma50_pct_min=100 finds unusual volume (trading at 2x+ its 50-day average). Returns CSV, one row per matching stock.

date.description: Trading date to evaluate the screen as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the latest available trading date when omitted.

sort.description: Column to rank results by. Defaults to rs_rating (relative-strength rating) when omitted.

limit.description: Max results to return; the underlying screener defaults to 20 when omitted.

is_52w_low.description: Filter to stocks at a 52-week low today.

tool.description: Get the daily foreign-shareholding percentage series for a CSE symbol — how much of the free float is held by foreign investors, tracked day by day. tool.description: Get a live price snapshot for CSE stocks -- price, change, and change% for one or more symbols, or every CSE stock at once. _published_faq.name: How do I add CeylonCharts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CeylonCharts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ceyloncharts.com/mcp.
